```{r setup, include=FALSE}
savefig <- function(
  filename,
  height = 10,
  width = (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2 * height,
  type = c("eps", "pdf", "jpg", "png"),
  pointsize = 10,
  family = "Helvetica",
  sublines = 0,
  toplines = 0,
  leftlines = 0,
  res = 300
) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  filename <- paste0(filename, ".", type)

  if (type == "eps") {
    postscript(
      file = filename,
      horizontal = FALSE,
      width = width / 2.54,
      height = height / 2.54,
      pointsize = pointsize,
      family = family,
      onefile = FALSE,
      print.it = FALSE
    )
  } else if (type == "pdf") {
    pdf(
      file = filename,
      width = width / 2.54,
      height = height / 2.54,
      pointsize = pointsize,
      family = family,
      onefile = TRUE
    )
  } else if (type == "jpg") {
    jpeg(
      filename = filename,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      res = res,
      quality = 100,
      units = "cm"
    )
  } else if (type == "png") {
    png(
      filename = filename,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      res = res,
      units = "cm"
    )
  }

  par(
    mgp = c(2.2, 0.45, 0),
    tcl = -0.4,
    mar = c(
      3.2 + sublines + 0.25 * (sublines > 0),
      3.5 + leftlines,
      1 + toplines,
      1
    ) + 0.1,
    pch = 1
  )

  invisible()
}

savepdf <- function(...) {
  savefig(..., type = "pdf")
}

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()

theme_set(paper_theme)

as_method_factor <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = method_levels)
}

attach_method <- function(data) {
  data |>
    rename(internal_method = method) |>
    inner_join(method_key, by = c("order_selection_method", "internal_method")) |>
    mutate(Method = as_method_factor(Method))
}
```

```{r}
plot_FACF_topright <- function(rho,Blueline,ci,...){
  # Define suitable lwd for plotting
  nlags <- length(rho)
  if(nlags <= 30){
    lwd_1 <- 8
  }else if(nlags <= 50){
    lwd_1 <- 6
  }else if(nlags <= 150){
    lwd_1 <- 4
  }else{
    lwd_1 <- 3
  }
  
  # Check if any additional plotting parameters are present
  arguments <- list(...)
  if(!"xlab" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$xlab <- "Lag"
  if(!"ylab" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$ylab <- "Autocorrelation"
  if(!"ylim" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$ylim <- c(0,max(rho)*1.5)
  if(!"lwd"  %in% names(arguments))   arguments$lwd  <- lwd_1
  if(!"las"  %in% names(arguments))   arguments$las  <- 1
  if(!"lend" %in% names(arguments))   arguments$lend  <- 2
  if(!"yaxs" %in% names(arguments))   arguments$yaxs  <- "i"
  if(!"xaxs" %in% names(arguments))   arguments$xaxs  <- "i"
  if(!"main" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$main  <- ""
  if(!"xlim" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$xlim  <- c(0,length(rho)+1)
  arguments$x = seq(1,length(rho),by = 1)
  arguments$y = rho
  arguments$type = "h"
  
  do.call(graphics::plot,arguments)
  grid(lty = 1)
  do.call(graphics::lines,arguments)
  graphics::lines(x = arguments$x, 
                  y = arguments$y,
                  type = arguments$type, 
                  col = "lightgrey", 
                  lwd = arguments$lwd-2, 
                  lend = 2);
  blue_color <- "#0073C2FF"
  graphics::abline(h = Blueline,col = blue_color,lwd = 4, lty = 2)
  graphics::legend(x = "topright",
                   legend = c(paste("i.i.d. bound (",ci*100," % conf.)",sep="")),
                   col = blue_color,
                   lty = 2,
                   lwd = 4)
  box()
}
```


# Fertility data

## Data and preprocessing

```{r data-functions}
repair_smooth <- function(raw, smooth) {
  raw <- as.matrix(raw)
  smooth <- as.matrix(smooth)
  smooth[!is.finite(smooth)] <- raw[!is.finite(smooth)]
  smooth
}

fertility_change <- function(x) {
  previous <- x[, -ncol(x), drop = FALSE]
  current <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  denominator <- previous + current
  change <- 2 * (previous - current) / denominator
  change[denominator == 0] <- 0
  colnames(change) <- colnames(x)[-1]
  change
}

fer <- read_rds("Empirical Study/demog_list_asfr.rds")
country_codes <- c(Slovakia = "SVK", France = "FRATNP")

fertility_data <- list()

for (country in names(country_codes)) {
  code <- country_codes[[country]]
  raw <- fer[[code]]$raw$rate[[paste0(code, "_ASFR")]] |> as.matrix()
  smooth <- fer[[code]]$smooth$rate[[paste0(code, "_ASFR")]] |> as.matrix()
  smooth <- repair_smooth(raw, smooth)

  fertility_data[[country]] <- list(
    raw = raw,
    smooth = smooth,
    raw_change = fertility_change(raw),
    smooth_change = fertility_change(smooth)
  )
}

slovakia_change <- fertility_data$Slovakia$smooth_change
france_change <- fertility_data$France$smooth_change

slovakia_centered <- sweep(
  slovakia_change,
  1,
  rowMeans(slovakia_change),
  "-"
)

france_centered <- sweep(
  france_change,
  1,
  rowMeans(france_change),
  "-"
)
```

## Stationarity checks

The stationarity checks use all available smoothed fertility-rate changes for each country. The null hypothesis of `ftsa::T_stationary()` is that the functional time series is stationary.

```{r stationarity-tests}
set.seed(123)
ftsa::T_stationary(
  sample = fertility_data$Slovakia$smooth_change,
  cumulative_var = 0.95,
  J = 100,
  MC_rep = 5000,
  pivotal = TRUE
)

set.seed(123)
ftsa::T_stationary(
  sample = fertility_data$France$smooth_change,
  cumulative_var = 0.95,
  J = 100,
  MC_rep = 5000,
  pivotal = TRUE
)
```


## Forecast

```{r run-models}
dir.create("Empirical Study/results", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

forecast_results <- list()

for (country in names(fertility_data)) {
  result_path <- file.path(
    "Empirical Study/results",
    paste0(tolower(country), "_fertility_change_forecast.rds")
  )

  if (!params$rerun_models && file.exists(result_path)) {
    result <- readRDS(result_path)
  } else {
    result <- rolling_forecasting_pipeline_compact_order_method(
      X = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth_change,
      h_max = 10,
      train_ratio = 0.7,
      valid_ratio = 0.15,
      alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
      window_types = "expanding",
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = 399,
      far_pve = 0.95,
      fracdiff_trim = 20,
      seed = 123,
      far_benchmark_d = 1,
      order_selection_method = "both",
      cv_order_window_type = "expanding",
      memory_cov_type = "sample"
    )

    saveRDS(result, result_path)
  }

  forecast_results[[country]] <- result
}

for (country in names(forecast_results)) {
  result <- forecast_results[[country]]
  benchmark <- result$error_detail |>
    filter(method == "far") |>
    arrange(order_selection_method, t0)

  ic <- benchmark |> filter(order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic")
  cv <- benchmark |> filter(order_selection_method == "cv_expanding")

  stopifnot(nrow(ic) == nrow(cv))
  stopifnot(identical(ic$t0, cv$t0))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ic))) {
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(ic$error[[i]], cv$error[[i]])))
  }
}
```

### Metrics


```{r metric-functions}
summarise_point_metrics <- function(result, fitted_data, observed_data) {
  error_data <- result$error_detail |>
    attach_method()

  metric_rows <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(error_data))) {
    error_matrix <- error_data$error[[i]]
    target_columns <- error_data$t0[i] + seq_len(ncol(error_matrix))
    forecast_matrix <-
      fitted_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE] + error_matrix
    evaluation_error <-
      forecast_matrix - observed_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE]

    metric_rows[[i]] <- tibble(
      Method = error_data$Method[i],
      h = seq_len(ncol(evaluation_error)),
      squared_error = colSums(evaluation_error^2),
      absolute_error = colSums(abs(evaluation_error)),
      n = nrow(evaluation_error)
    )
  }

  bind_rows(metric_rows) |>
    group_by(Method, h) |>
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(sum(squared_error) / sum(n)),
      MAE = sum(absolute_error) / sum(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

summarise_interval_metrics <- function(result, fitted_data, observed_data) {
  error_data <- result$error_detail |>
    attach_method()
  calibration_data <- result$calibration_detail |>
    attach_method()
  metric_rows <- list()
  row_index <- 0L

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(error_data))) {
    error_matrix <- error_data$error[[i]]
    target_columns <- error_data$t0[i] + seq_len(ncol(error_matrix))
    forecast_matrix <-
      fitted_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE] + error_matrix
    evaluation_error <-
      forecast_matrix - observed_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE]
    method_calibration <- calibration_data |>
      filter(Method == error_data$Method[i])

    for (j in seq_len(nrow(method_calibration))) {
      alpha_now <- method_calibration$alpha[j]
      gamma_now <- method_calibration$gamma[[j]]
      zeta_now <- method_calibration$zeta[[j]]

      for (h_now in seq_len(ncol(evaluation_error))) {
        error_now <- evaluation_error[, h_now]
        half_width <- zeta_now[h_now] * as.numeric(gamma_now[[h_now]])
        keep <- is.finite(error_now) & is.finite(half_width)
        error_now <- error_now[keep]
        half_width <- half_width[keep]
        interval_score <-
          2 * half_width +
          (2 / alpha_now) * pmax(abs(error_now) - half_width, 0)

        row_index <- row_index + 1L
        metric_rows[[row_index]] <- tibble(
          Method = error_data$Method[i],
          alpha = alpha_now,
          h = h_now,
          covered = sum(abs(error_now) <= half_width),
          score_sum = sum(interval_score),
          n = length(error_now)
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(metric_rows) |>
    group_by(Method, alpha, h) |>
    summarise(
      covered = sum(covered),
      score_sum = sum(score_sum),
      n = sum(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      ECP = covered / n,
      CPD = abs(ECP - (1 - alpha)),
      Score = score_sum / n
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(Method, alpha, h, ECP, CPD, Score)
}

summarise_wis <- function(point, interval) {
  interval |>
    group_by(Method, h) |>
    summarise(
      K = n_distinct(alpha),
      weighted_interval = sum((alpha / 2) * Score),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(point |> dplyr::select(Method, h, MAE), by = c("Method", "h")) |>
    mutate(WIS = (0.5 * MAE + weighted_interval) / (K + 0.5)) |>
    dplyr::select(Method, h, WIS)
}

metric_results <- list()

for (country in names(forecast_results)) {
  result <- forecast_results[[country]]
  point <- summarise_point_metrics(
    result,
    fitted_data = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth_change,
    observed_data = fertility_data[[country]]$raw_change
  )
  interval <- summarise_interval_metrics(
    result,
    fitted_data = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth_change,
    observed_data = fertility_data[[country]]$raw_change
  )
  wis <- summarise_wis(point, interval)

  metric_results[[country]] <- list(
    point = point,
    interval = interval,
    wis = wis
  )
}

point_metric_list <- list()
interval_metric_list <- list()
wis_metric_list <- list()

for (country in names(metric_results)) {
  point_metric_list[[country]] <- metric_results[[country]]$point |>
    mutate(Country = country, .before = 1)
  interval_metric_list[[country]] <- metric_results[[country]]$interval |>
    mutate(Country = country, .before = 1)
  wis_metric_list[[country]] <- metric_results[[country]]$wis |>
    mutate(Country = country, .before = 1)
}

point_metrics <- bind_rows(point_metric_list)
interval_metrics <- bind_rows(interval_metric_list)
wis_metrics <- bind_rows(wis_metric_list)

point_ratios <- point_metrics |>
  left_join(
    point_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Country, h, benchmark_RMSE = RMSE, benchmark_MAE = MAE),
    by = c("Country", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `RMSE ratio` = RMSE / benchmark_RMSE,
    `MAE ratio` = MAE / benchmark_MAE
  )

interval_ratios <- interval_metrics |>
  left_join(
    interval_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Country, alpha, h, benchmark_Score = Score),
    by = c("Country", "alpha", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`Score ratio` = Score / benchmark_Score)

wis_ratios <- wis_metrics |>
  left_join(
    wis_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Country, h, benchmark_WIS = WIS),
    by = c("Country", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`WIS ratio` = WIS / benchmark_WIS)
```

### Point accuracy and WIS

The compact table reports values and benchmark ratios at horizons 1, 5, and 10. RMSE, MAE, ECP, CPD, interval score, and WIS compare the forecasts fitted to the smoothed changes with the corresponding raw fertility-rate changes. All ten horizons remain visible in the figures.

```{r point-wis-table}
point_ratios |>
  left_join(
    wis_ratios |> dplyr::select(Country, Method, h, WIS, `WIS ratio`),
    by = c("Country", "Method", "h")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Country,
    h,
    Method,
    RMSE,
    `RMSE ratio`,
    MAE,
    `MAE ratio`,
    WIS,
    `WIS ratio`
  ) |>
  arrange(Country, h, Method)
```

```{r point-ratio-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
point_ratio_plot_data <- point_ratios |>

ggplot(

  scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes, breaks = c("Functional IC", "CV")) +
```

```{r wis-ratio-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.5}
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = method_shapes,
    breaks = c("Functional IC", "CV")

    breaks = c("Functional IC", "CV")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(
    title = "Weighted interval score relative to the benchmark",
    subtitle = "The horizontal line at one is the benchmark; WIS combines the point forecast and both intervals",
    x = "Forecast horizon h",
    y = "Ratio"
  )
```

### Forecast plot

The final comparison uses the most recent test origin for which all ten forecast horizons are observed. The 80% and 95% bands are shown in separate figures to avoid overlapping the two coverage levels. Within every panel, the observed curve, all three point forecasts, and the bands for all three methods are compared directly.

```{r forecast-band-functions}
extract_forecast_bands <- function(result, x, observed_x, country, alpha_show = c(0.20, 0.05)) {
  forecast_rows <- result$error_detail |>
    attach_method()

  forecast_rows$n_horizons <- integer(nrow(forecast_rows))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(forecast_rows))) {
    forecast_rows$n_horizons[i] <- ncol(forecast_rows$error[[i]])
  }

  forecast_rows <- forecast_rows |>
    filter(n_horizons >= 10)

  latest_t0 <- forecast_rows |>
    distinct(t0, Method) |>
    dplyr::count(t0) |>
    filter(n == length(method_levels)) |>
    summarise(t0 = max(t0)) |>
    pull(t0)

  calibration_rows <- result$calibration_detail |>
    attach_method() |>
    filter(alpha %in% alpha_show)

  band_rows <- list()
  row_index <- 0L

  for (method_now in method_levels) {
    method_forecast <- forecast_rows |>
      filter(t0 == latest_t0, Method == method_now) |>
      slice(1)

    error_matrix <- method_forecast$error[[1]]

    fitted_matrix <- x[, latest_t0 + seq_len(10), drop = FALSE]
    observed_matrix <- observed_x[, latest_t0 + seq_len(10), drop = FALSE]
    forecast_matrix <-
      fitted_matrix + error_matrix[, seq_len(10), drop = FALSE]

    method_calibration <- calibration_rows |>
      filter(Method == method_now) |>
      arrange(desc(alpha))

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(method_calibration))) {
      alpha_now <- method_calibration$alpha[i]
      gamma_now <- method_calibration$gamma[[i]]
      zeta_now <- method_calibration$zeta[[i]]

      for (h_now in seq_len(10)) {
        half_width <- zeta_now[h_now] * as.numeric(gamma_now[[h_now]])
        row_index <- row_index + 1L
        band_rows[[row_index]] <- tibble(
            Country = country,
            Method = as_method_factor(method_now),
            `Interval level` = factor(
              scales::percent(1 - alpha_now, accuracy = 1),
              levels = c("95%", "80%")
            ),
            h = h_now,
            panel = paste0("h = ", h_now),
            age = parse_number(rownames(x)),
            observed = observed_matrix[, h_now],
            forecast = forecast_matrix[, h_now],
            lower = forecast_matrix[, h_now] - half_width,
            upper = forecast_matrix[, h_now] + half_width
          )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(band_rows)
}

forecast_band_list <- list()

for (country in names(forecast_results)) {
  forecast_band_list[[country]] <- extract_forecast_bands(
    result = forecast_results[[country]],
    x = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth_change,
    observed_x = fertility_data[[country]]$raw_change,
    country = country
  )
}

forecast_band_data <- bind_rows(forecast_band_list) |>
  mutate(
    panel = factor(
      panel,
      levels = paste0("h = ", 1:10)
    )
  )
```




```{r forecast-band-plots, results='asis', fig.width=13, fig.height=8.5}
plot_method_levels <- c("Benchmark", "Functional IC", "CV")
plot_method_palette <- c(
  "Benchmark" = "#1B9E77",
  "Functional IC" = "#D95F02",
  "CV" = "#7570B3"
)
plot_method_linetypes <- c("Benchmark" = "longdash",
                           "Functional IC" = "solid",
                           "CV" = "dotdash")

for (country_now in names(fertility_data)) {
  plot_data <- forecast_band_data |>
    filter(Country == country_now) |>
    mutate(
      `Plot method` = recode(as.character(Method), `Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))` = "Benchmark"),
      `Plot method` = factor(`Plot method`, levels = plot_method_levels)
    )
  
  observed_data <- plot_data |>
    distinct(panel, h, age, observed)
  
  point_data <- plot_data |>
    distinct(panel, h, age, `Plot method`, forecast)
  
  for (interval_now in c("80%", "95%")) {
    band_data <- plot_data |>
      filter(`Interval level` == interval_now)
    
    forecast_plot <- ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(
        data = band_data,
        aes(
          x = age,
          ymin = lower,
          ymax = upper,
          fill = `Plot method`,
          group = `Plot method`
        ),
        alpha = 0.14,
        colour = NA
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = observed_data,
        aes(age, observed),
        colour = "#111111",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = point_data,
        aes(
          age,
          forecast,
          colour = `Plot method`,
          linetype = `Plot method`,
          group = `Plot method`
        ),
        linewidth = 1
      ) +
      facet_wrap( ~ panel, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_colour_manual(name = "Point forecast",
                          values = plot_method_palette,
                          drop = FALSE) +
      scale_linetype_manual(name = "Point forecast",
                            values = plot_method_linetypes,
                            drop = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        name = paste(interval_now, "prediction band"),
        values = plot_method_palette,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      guides(
        colour = guide_legend(
          order = 1,
          override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2)
        ),
        linetype = guide_legend(order = 1),
        fill = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(alpha = 0.7))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(country_now, interval_now, "fertility-change forecasts"),
        subtitle = "Raw observed change: black solid line; benchmark: green long-dashed line",
        x = "Age",
        y = "Fertility-rate change"
      ) +
      theme(legend.box = "vertical", plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 16))
    
    print(forecast_plot)
  }
}
```



# France mortality analysis


## Mortality data and processing

```{r mortality-load-data}
france_demogdata <- demography::read.demogdata(
  file = "Empirical Study/Mortality Data/FRATNP_Mx_1x1.txt",
  popfile = "Empirical Study/Mortality Data/FRATNP_Exposures_1x1.txt",
  type = "mortality",
  label = "France"
) |>
  demography::extract.ages(0:95)

for (sex in c("female", "male")) {
  france_demogdata$rate[[sex]][
    france_demogdata$rate[[sex]] <= 0 |
      france_demogdata$rate[[sex]] > 1
  ] <- NA_real_

  for (age in seq_len(nrow(france_demogdata$rate[[sex]]))) {
    france_demogdata$rate[[sex]][age, ] <- imputeTS::na_interpolation(
      france_demogdata$rate[[sex]][age, ],
      option = "linear"
    )
  }
}

france_smoothed <- demography::smooth.demogdata(
  france_demogdata,
  method = "mspline",
  b = 65,
  weight = TRUE
)

keep_years <- france_demogdata$year >= 1861

mortality_data <- list(
  years = france_demogdata$year[keep_years],
  ages = france_demogdata$age,
  female_log = log10(
    france_demogdata$rate$female[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  ),
  male_log = log10(
    france_demogdata$rate$male[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  ),
  female_smooth_log = log10(
    france_smoothed$rate$female[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  ),
  male_smooth_log = log10(
    france_smoothed$rate$male[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  )
)

mortality_series <- list(
  Female = mortality_data$female_smooth_log,
  Male = mortality_data$male_smooth_log
)

mortality_raw_series <- list(
  Female = mortality_data$female_log,
  Male = mortality_data$male_log
)
```

## Stationarity checks

The null hypothesis of `ftsa::T_stationary()` is that the functional time series is stationary. The checks below use all 163 smoothed log-mortality curves and are descriptive; the forecast pipeline still estimates its parameters from the initial training sample only.

```{r mortality-stationarity-tests}
for (sex in names(mortality_series)) {
  cat("\n", sex, " mortality\n", sep = "")

  set.seed(123)
  ftsa::T_stationary(
    sample = mortality_series[[sex]],
    cumulative_var = 0.95,
    J = 100,
    MC_rep = 5000,
    h = sqrt(ncol(mortality_series[[sex]])),
    pivotal = TRUE
  )
}
```

## France mortality expanding-window forecast study

The smoothed log-mortality matrices are passed directly to `rolling_forecasting_pipeline_compact_order_method()`. The function creates the 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% test samples internally; no mortality curves are split manually in this Rmd. Point forecast errors are evaluated against the corresponding raw log-mortality curves. The remaining settings are \(h=1,\ldots,10\), `p_max = q_max = 5`, `Npc = 1`, `B = 399`, an expanding window, and central 80% and 95% conformal intervals.

```{r mortality-run-models}
dir.create("Empirical Study/results", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

mortality_forecast_results <- list()

for (sex in names(mortality_series)) {
  result_path <- file.path(
    "Empirical Study/results",
    paste0("france_", tolower(sex), "_mortality_forecast.rds")
  )

  if (!params$rerun_models && file.exists(result_path)) {
    result <- readRDS(result_path)
  } else {
    result <- rolling_forecasting_pipeline_compact_order_method(
      X = mortality_series[[sex]],
      h_max = 10,
      train_ratio = 0.70,
      valid_ratio = 0.15,
      alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
      window_types = "expanding",
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = 399,
      far_pve = 0.95,
      fracdiff_trim = 20,
      seed = 123,
      far_benchmark_d = 1,
      order_selection_method = "both",
      cv_order_window_type = "expanding",
      memory_cov_type = "sample"
    )

    saveRDS(result, result_path)
  }

  mortality_forecast_results[[sex]] <- result
}

for (sex in names(mortality_forecast_results)) {
  benchmark <- mortality_forecast_results[[sex]]$error_detail |>
    filter(method == "far") |>
    arrange(order_selection_method, t0)

  ic <- benchmark |>
    filter(order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic")
  cv <- benchmark |>
    filter(order_selection_method == "cv_expanding")

  stopifnot(nrow(ic) == nrow(cv))
  stopifnot(identical(ic$t0, cv$t0))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ic))) {
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(ic$error[[i]], cv$error[[i]])))
  }
}
```

### Selected mortality models

```{r mortality-selected-models}
mortality_selected_models_list <- list()

for (sex in names(mortality_forecast_results)) {
  result <- mortality_forecast_results[[sex]]
  selected <- result$model_summary |>
    filter(order_selection_method %in% c("adaptive_ic", "cv_expanding")) |>
    transmute(
      Sex = sex,
      Method = recode(
        order_selection_method,
        adaptive_ic = "Functional IC",
        cv_expanding = "CV"
      ),
      d = d_hat,
      p = p_est,
      q = q_est
    )

  mortality_selected_models_list[[sex]] <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      Sex = sex,
      Method = "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))",
      d = 1,
      p = 1L,
      q = 0L
    ),
    selected
  ) |>
    mutate(
      Method = as_method_factor(Method),
      Model = sprintf("FARFIMA(%d, %.4f, %d)", p, d, q)
    )
}

mortality_selected_models <- bind_rows(mortality_selected_models_list)

mortality_selected_models |>
  arrange(Sex, Method) |>

  kable(caption = "France mortality models fixed before test evaluation")
```

### Mortality metrics

```{r mortality-metrics}
mortality_metric_results <- list()

for (sex in names(mortality_forecast_results)) {
  result <- mortality_forecast_results[[sex]]
  point <- summarise_point_metrics(
    result,
    fitted_data = mortality_series[[sex]],
    observed_data = mortality_raw_series[[sex]]
  )
  interval <- summarise_interval_metrics(
    result,
    fitted_data = mortality_series[[sex]],
    observed_data = mortality_raw_series[[sex]]
  )
  wis <- summarise_wis(point, interval)

  mortality_metric_results[[sex]] <- list(
    point = point,
    interval = interval,
    wis = wis
  )
}

mortality_point_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mortality_metric_results), function(sex) {
    mortality_metric_results[[sex]]$point |>
      mutate(Sex = sex, .before = 1)
  })
)

mortality_interval_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mortality_metric_results), function(sex) {
    mortality_metric_results[[sex]]$interval |>
      mutate(Sex = sex, .before = 1)
  })
)

mortality_wis_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mortality_metric_results), function(sex) {
    mortality_metric_results[[sex]]$wis |>
      mutate(Sex = sex, .before = 1)
  })
)

mortality_point_ratios <- mortality_point_metrics |>
  left_join(
    mortality_point_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Sex, h, benchmark_RMSE = RMSE, benchmark_MAE = MAE),
    by = c("Sex", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `RMSE ratio` = RMSE / benchmark_RMSE,
    `MAE ratio` = MAE / benchmark_MAE
  )

mortality_interval_ratios <- mortality_interval_metrics |>
  left_join(
    mortality_interval_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Sex, alpha, h, benchmark_Score = Score),
    by = c("Sex", "alpha", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`Score ratio` = Score / benchmark_Score)

mortality_wis_ratios <- mortality_wis_metrics |>
  left_join(
    mortality_wis_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Sex, h, benchmark_WIS = WIS),
    by = c("Sex", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`WIS ratio` = WIS / benchmark_WIS)
```

```{r mortality-wis-ratio-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.5}
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_palette, breaks = c("Functional IC", "CV")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes, breaks = c("Functional IC", "CV")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = method_linetypes, breaks = c("Functional IC", "CV")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(
    title = "France mortality weighted interval score ratios",
    subtitle = "The horizontal line at one is the benchmark; lower values are better",
    x = "Forecast horizon h",
    y = "WIS ratio"
  )
```

#### Interval coverage and score

```{r mortality-interval-table}
mortality_interval_ratios |>
  mutate(`Interval level` = scales::percent(1 - alpha, accuracy = 1)) |>
  filter(h %in% c(1, 5, 10)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Sex,
    `Interval level`,
    h,
    Method,
    ECP,
    CPD,
    Score,
    `Score ratio`
  ) |>
  arrange(Sex, `Interval level`, h, Method) |>
  kable(
    digits = 4,
    caption = "France mortality interval results at selected horizons"
  )
```

```{r mortality-coverage-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
mortality_coverage_plot_data <- mortality_interval_metrics |>

ggplot(

) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1 - alpha), colour = "grey50", linetype = 3) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "France mortality empirical coverage probability",
    subtitle = "Horizontal lines show the nominal coverage",
    x = "Forecast horizon h",
    y = "ECP"
  )
```

```{r mortality-score-ratio-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
mortality_score_ratio_plot_data <- mortality_interval_ratios |>

  scale_linetype_manual(values = method_linetypes, breaks = c("Functional IC", "CV")) +

  )
```

### France mortality point and interval forecasts

The figures use the latest test origin for which all ten horizons are observed. Each panel compares the raw observed log-mortality curve with the three point forecasts fitted to smoothed log mortality. The method-specific 80% and 95% bands are shown in separate figures.

```{r mortality-forecast-band-data}
mortality_forecast_band_list <- list()

for (sex in names(mortality_forecast_results)) {
  mortality_forecast_band_list[[sex]] <- extract_forecast_bands(
    result = mortality_forecast_results[[sex]],
    x = mortality_series[[sex]],
    observed_x = mortality_raw_series[[sex]],
    country = sex
  )
}

mortality_forecast_band_data <- bind_rows(mortality_forecast_band_list) |>
  rename(Sex = Country) |>
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = paste0("h = ", 1:10)))
```

```{r mortality-forecast-band-plots, results='asis', fig.width=13, fig.height=8.5}
for (sex_now in names(mortality_forecast_results)) {
  plot_data <- mortality_forecast_band_data |>
    filter(Sex == sex_now) |>
    mutate(
      `Plot method` = recode(
        as.character(Method),
        `Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))` = "Benchmark"
      ),
      `Plot method` = factor(`Plot method`, levels = plot_method_levels)
    )

  observed_data <- plot_data |>
    distinct(panel, h, age, observed)

  point_data <- plot_data |>
    distinct(panel, h, age, `Plot method`, forecast)

  for (interval_now in c("80%", "95%")) {
    band_data <- plot_data |>
      filter(`Interval level` == interval_now)

    mortality_forecast_plot <- ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(
        data = band_data,
        aes(
          x = age,
          ymin = lower,
          ymax = upper,
          fill = `Plot method`,
          group = `Plot method`
        ),
        alpha = 0.14,
        colour = NA
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = observed_data,
        aes(age, observed),
        colour = "#111111",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = point_data,
        aes(
          age,
          forecast,
          colour = `Plot method`,
          linetype = `Plot method`,
          group = `Plot method`
        ),
        linewidth = 1
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_colour_manual(
        name = "Point forecast",
        values = plot_method_palette,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_linetype_manual(
        name = "Point forecast",
        values = plot_method_linetypes,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        name = paste(interval_now, "prediction band"),
        values = plot_method_palette,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      guides(
        colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2)),
        linetype = guide_legend(order = 1),
        fill = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(alpha = 0.7))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("France", tolower(sex_now), interval_now, "mortality forecasts"),
        subtitle = "Raw observed curve: black solid line; forecasts and bands use matching method colours",
        x = "Age",
        y = "Log mortality rate"
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.box = "vertical",
        plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 16)
      )

    print(mortality_forecast_plot)
  }
}
```
